shortDescription: Hyperliquid Strategies increased its stock buyback program from $30 million to $100 million, with approximately $72 million remaining and the deadline extended to October 31, 2027. According to ChainCatcher, the company dashboard shows it holds approximately 38.8 million HYPE.
